name: Hand Cranked Flipbook Animation Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Expertly crafted from solid wood for a timeless, elegant appearance and long-lasting durability.

- Features a smooth wooden hand crank for comfortable operation.
- Equipped with high-quality acrylic gears that ensure smooth photo movement and reliable performance.
- Built-in rechargeable LED light with three lighting modes (Warm Light, White Light, and Yellow Light) to enhance your photos in any setting.
- USB rechargeable with an easy-to-use touch switch.

- Available with 8 or 16 custom photos to create a seamless animated flipbook effect.
 

Sizes & Dimensions: Compact cube design measuring 8 × 8 × 8 cm (3.1 × 3.1 × 3.1 in).

Printing + Engraving  Technology:

- Personalized using sublimation printing on durable 150G self-adhesive photo paper.

- An optional precision engraving on the top surface of the box lets you personalize it with heartfelt messages, names, dates, or meaningful quotes.

-Produces vibrant colors, sharp details, and smooth image transitions.

 

Functional & Usage:
- Perfect size for displaying on desks, bedside tables, bookshelves, or office spaces without taking up much room.
- Built-in LED lighting highlights every image and creates a warm, eye-catching display.

- Easy photo replacement system allows you to reinstall photos if needed.

- Combines decorative lighting, personalized photo display, and interactive entertainment in one unique keepsake.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
Celebrate life's most meaningful moments with a personalized gift that will be treasured for years. The Hand Cranked Flipbook Animation Box is a thoughtful choice for: Weddings & Anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Birthdays, Mother's Day & Father's Day, Christmas,  Graduations,…

 

SPECIFICATION

Processing Time: 5-7 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
Packaging: 1 x  Hand Cranked Flipbook Animation Box

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
  • Rotate the hand crank counterclockwise to smoothly animate your personalized photo sequence.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
